primary.disposition: Entry scope names actual resource/alias-or-index external-state ownership; current factory consumers are request-only HTTP plus Stream, no unsupported response-stage sharing.

One protocol-independent Redis executor serves HTTP/Stream request rates and AI quota/reservations. Immutable process script descriptors, exact NOSCRIPT-only fallback, canonical numeric validation, opaque same-slot keys and strict typed result projection retain one owner; caller deadlines/failure/settlement remain separate policy.

Five atomic Lua families retain actual algorithm semantics: bounded aggregate+separate idempotent marker, conditional/force cumulative update, reservation/reconcile/release and fractional token refill on both branches. No duplicate executor, remote preload or whole-multipolicy transaction introduced.

support_scope: Original canonical Redis/entry/caching/settlement sections and actual consumers/selected unit source contracts inspected. Local algorithm tests and source-string guards are not real Redis evidence.
limits: Static source only; no Redis, Lua execution, tests/builds or measurement. Existing raw-key truncation and independent multi-policy debit semantics retained; arbitrary trusted Redis state corruption not established as new architecture root.
